steps: Peel and dice Sweet potato into 1 cm cubes; finely dice Onion and mince Garlic.
Cook Rice according to package directions in a medium saucepan; set aside.
Heat Olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, 180 °C (350 °F).
Add Onion and Garlic; cook 3 to 4 minutes, until softened and translucent.
Add Ground turkey; cook 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it apart, until no pink remains.
Stir in Sweet potato, Cumin, Turmeric, and Salt; stir well to coat.
Pour in Unsalted chicken broth; cover and cook 8 to 10 minutes, until Sweet potato is fork-tender.
Spoon Rice into bowls and top with the turkey and sweet potato mixture.
Yield: 4 family portions. Refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 2 days.
